blocks.text: On activation of the fire alarm or emergency notification system, the Facilities team immediately initiates evacuation of all occupants. Any employee who observes a fire or imminent hazard may and must initiate evacuation without waiting for approval.
Security personnel sweep all floors to confirm that all occupants have evacuated. Simultaneously, the office manager notifies building management and calls 911.
The incident commander accounts for all personnel at the designated assembly point. HR provides a headcount list to the incident commander upon request.
Once the all-clear is received from emergency services, the incident commander authorizes re-entry of the facility. No re-entry is permitted until the incident commander issues authorization.

messages.text: Facilities update: employees now check in digitally by texting SAFE to 555-0100 at the assembly point. The incident commander tracks headcount via the digital dashboard instead of paper lists, effective immediately.
